player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} ({role}) deg urar n Matching Pennies i {num_rounds} n tefriwin.
- Yal tefriw, ɛrek [heads] neɣ [tails] (neɣ [h], [t]).
- Ma d nuɣa-k ɛreḍ ad yeǧǧ yifrax-ik, Imiraz 0 iṛuḥ tefriw; neɣni Imiraz 1 iṛuḥ.
ɛrek-d tamagit-ik s tseɣlint '[heads]' neɣ '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Ajmuɛ 0 yebɛɛd '{choice0}'; Ajmuɛ 1 yebɛɛd '{choice1}'. Talmest -> Ajmuɛ 0 yettwassen.
message.round_mismatch: Ajmuɛ 0 yebɛɛd '{choice0}'; Ajmuɛ 1 yebɛɛd '{choice1}'. Ur tɣuri -> Ajmuɛ 1 yettwassen.

outcome.p0_wins: Amyur n 0 yerbeḥ ugar n yiberdan.
